cases.name: rejected unseen retirement releases its acquired lease without changing any saved life
session-only cleanup preserves progress, backup and unknown envelope metadata
lease cleanup refuses another owner even when its beat is stale
retried cleanup callback rechecks the latest owner
cleanup retries transient failure with backoff and resolves a lost success response
metadata cleanup follows request budget and cannot renew a lease while waiting
unknown or damaged progress is never rewritten just to remove its lock
successful explicit reload cancels stale cleanup and keeps the renewed active lease
departure cleanup preserves dirty candidates and respects its deadline

scope: Actual native preserve captures for Normal/Free/Easy, then nine synthetic MemoryBackend session cases through Studio-only playback. No online DataStore, physical device, network or performance proof.
